name: Fit MAPMRI
summary: Fits the MAPMRI diffusion model to DWI with DIPY 1.1.1 dipy_fit_mapmri (Laplacian and/or positivity regularisation) and outputs RTOP, RTAP, RTPP, MSD, QIV, Laplacian norm and non-Gaussianity maps.
description: Wraps the DIPY dipy_fit_mapmri workflow (Mean Apparent Propagator MRI) on a DWI with its bvals and bvecs, inside the brainlife/dipy:1.1.1 container. Use it to compute propagator-based microstructure scalars from multi-shell DWI. At least one of laplacian or positivity must be enabled; small_delta and big_delta (diffusion timing) are passed to the workflow to build the gradient table.

outputs.description: Output folder of dipy_fit_mapmri with the scalar maps (rtop, lapnorm, msd, qiv, rtap, rtpp, ng, parallel ng, perpendicular ng).

parameters.description: DIPY workflow to run; only dipy_fit_mapmri is accepted.

Small delta value used in generation of gradient table of provided
bval and bvec.

Big delta value used in generation of gradient table of provided
bval and bvec.
Threshold used to find b=0 directions (default 0.0)

Sets the b-value threshold to be used in the scale factor
estimation. In order for the estimated non-Gaussianity to have
meaning this value should set to a lower value (b<2000 s/mm^2)
such that the scale factors are estimated on signal points that
reasonably represent the spins at Gaussian diffusion

Weighting value used in fitting the MAPMRI model in the laplacian
and both model types. (default: 0.05)

Even value used to set the order of the basis
(default: 6)
Regularize using the Laplacian of the MAP-MRI basis (default True)
Constrain the propagator to be positive. (default True)
